notes: Background: multi-tenant agent platform for SMB+mid-market customers (customer success + automated triage).
Initial ask: validate Hosted API for chat + tool-calling with strict latency SLOs, then evaluate Dedicated for burst predictability and rate-limit isolation.
Latency SLOs quoted by engineering: streaming first-byte <150ms for p50, p95 end-to-end response <600ms for 1:1 chat flows; concurrent tenant sessions target 400-600 active users per region.

POC scope proposed: 4 weeks on Hosted API, run synthetic tenant traffic from us-east and us-west simulating 50 tenants with variable qps; measure streaming stability, reconnect behavior, and tool-calling reliability.
SE feedback: will provide sample harness (k6-based) + example tool-calling adapters; need sample rate-limit headers and streaming reconnection guidance from Redwood.
Pricing convo: wants line-item showing Hosted per-token + potential Dedicated commit tiers; procurement requested 12/6/3 month breakouts and overage model.
Security: customer security team requires SSO (SAML) and audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance; need clarification on KMS integration and data residency for EU customers.
Multi-tenant concerns raised by platform lead (quote): "We need per-tenant rate quotas and per-route concurrency caps — cannot have noisy tenants starve others."

Product notes: interested in streaming keep-alive behavior, reconnect jitter handling, and tool-call payload size limits. Also cares about prompt caching and KV cache reuse across sessions to reduce cost.
Recent activity: demo 2025-04-23 (Marcus + Leah) walked through streaming/func-calling demo; follow-up call 2025-05-01 covered preliminary POC metrics and security checklist.

Decision criteria: 1) meets latency SLOs on Hosted with streaming; 2) per-tenant quota controls + dashboarding; 3) predictable cost model for 100-500 tenants; 4) SOC2/SSO readiness for Dedicated procurement.
Internal notes (AE): prioritize providing a small sandbox tenant mapping and a sample billing estimate. Lean on 'Optimize' recommendations for batching to show cost delta during POC.
Next meetings: SE onboarding call scheduled 2025-05-05 (ff_20250505_se_onboard).
Stated timeline by customer: POC in May -> procurement review in June -> target decision July 2025.
